Review report summary ({case_id}, {date})
Subject: The capacity test of the battery bank at an access equipment room at {site} failed; the float voltage was 2.18V per cell (threshold 2.23V), and the backup duration dropped from 4 hours to 35 minutes. - Call rule: a backup duration of less than 1 hour is regarded as high risk, and the on-duty staff must be called in immediately.
Additional note: The complaint ticket {ticket} from {customer} has been closed by the front desk and requires no follow-up.
